author: Pálfy Zoltán
description: A dependency-light Ruby client for the Hungarian Tax Authority's (NAV) Online Invoice API v3.0: request signing, XSD validation, rate limiting and typed errors. Works without Rails; an optional Railtie is provided for Rails applications.

author: PowerTom contributors
description: PowerTom is a PowerPoint template engine for Ruby. Designers keep the template in PowerPoint; engineers pass a Ruby Hash or a TOML file and get a finished deck. Layout, fonts, colours, masters and theme stay under the designer's control.
